_rules: Queue for the daily blog job. scripts/blog-next-topic.mjs picks today's topic from the weekday slot in plan.json (priority topics first). Fields: category (format), pillar (use-case | feature | language | basics), covers (feature ids from the Feature map in CAPTIO_FACTS.md, use-case slugs, language slugs), status (queued | published + slug + published | blocked + reason | skipped + reason), priority (true = write next, set by the new-version check). Titles are working titles. When fewer than 14 are queued, add 20 new topics, filling the gaps npm run blog:coverage shows.
